name: Jfresolve
description: Stream and resolve external media sources directly through Jellyfin.
overview: Simplify external playback — Jfresolve automatically finds and streams external media from stremio.

versions.changelog: Fixed auto-population hanging indefinitely (series lock was never released). Streams now resume automatically when the debrid host drops the connection (fixes 4K remux playback failures). Preferred quality is now a ceiling: falls back to the next lower quality instead of jumping to 4K. Added optional .strm file mode for third-party clients like Infuse. Clearer logging for 403 errors from the addon or stream host. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6+.

Fixed plugin image not loading: Added embedded resource for jfresolve.png and created Image endpoint to serve it. Added route handling for both /Plugins/Jfresolve/Image and /Plugins/{guid}/{version}/Image patterns. Thanks to @ dennisstorm-hass
Added failover system for dead links with configurable time windows. Code cleanup and optimization. Improved quality version support with individual stream probing.
Added new classifications for auto populate. Thanks to @Ajayrajasekaran
Code overhaul, new methods for search, save and auto populate, new instructions
Targeted library refresh after search added
Jfresolve plugin for jellyfin version 10.11.x.x - Added configurable library population scheduling, fixed plugin disposal on uninstall, improved version segmentation
